title: Hardware Procurement Shipping Methods and Delivery Targets
content:
Hardware Procurement orders ship by the order type's standard shipping method. The delivery target is counted in business days from the purchase order to delivery and applies to in-stock items; it is a target, not a guarantee.

| Order type | Standard shipping method | Signature required at the client site | May ship in partial lots | Delivery target for in-stock items (business days from purchase order) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Accessory & Peripheral Order | ground | No | Yes | 3 |
| Standard Endpoint Order | ground with signature | Yes | Yes | 5 |
| Staged Endpoint Order | ground with signature | Yes | No | 10 |
| Network Equipment Order | ground with signature | Yes | No | 10 |
| Server & Storage Build Order | freight | Yes | No | 15 |
| Special-Order Equipment | freight | Yes | No | 30 |

**Partial lots.** Only Accessory & Peripheral Orders and Standard Endpoint Orders may ship in partial lots, and even then the final invoice is still raised on full delivery of the order. Every other order type ships complete.

**Signature.** Every order type except the Accessory & Peripheral Order requires a signature on delivery at the client's site.
